Word Scrambler

Scramble the interior letters of every word while keeping the first and last letters in place.

Interior letters are jumbled; first and last letters stay put.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your text.
  2. Press Scramble.
  3. Copy the result or scramble again.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why is it still readable?

Yes — research shows text stays readable when only interior letters are jumbled.

What about short words?

Words of 3 letters or fewer and punctuation are left untouched.

Is the scrambling different each time?

Yes — press Scramble again for a fresh jumbling of the same text.
